items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Vest showed me that one day.

ctx.x: No, it didn't have no park. It just said it was a green we called it. Like South America.
Yeah. Vest showed me that one day. He mentioned something about, I believe, was it Perseverance?
Perseverance, that's what's back there, Belvin and Lamar.
